outcome: Objects and effects of the subgame have no meaning in the main game, except the winner or loser result the effect references.
A subgame starts with each player's main-game library moved to a new subgame library and shuffled, and a random player goes first.
Supplementary decks move to the subgame command zone and are shuffled as a subgame begins.
A player with fewer than seven cards in library loses the subgame at the first upkeep state-based check.
Main-game objects and outside cards are outside the subgame, except those specifically brought in.
A card brought into a subgame from the main game fires leave-zone triggers that are put on the stack only when the main game resumes.
Main-game counters are absent in the subgame and return on resumption, and subgame counters vanish when it ends.
At the subgame's end each player's traditional cards return shuffled to the main-game library, the creating ability finishes resolving, then deferred triggers go on the stack.
At the subgame's end nontraditional cards go face down to the bottom of their supplementary deck and the decks return to the main-game command zone shuffled.
A subgame created within a subgame makes the existing subgame the main game relative to the new one.
